row: Welcome to our channel! Our videos feature stories about our large and small animal care and our awesome practice team! Our practice is unique in that we provide medical care to multiple species in the greater Tucson, Arizona area. Three of our veterinarians specialize in the care of dogs and cats and the other three veterinarians specialize in the care of horses and livestock. We are proud to say that Adobe Veterinary Center is AAHA (American Animal Hospital Association) certified.
